title: Spots
intro: Every STREET DEX spot, newest first. Signals are computed when the list is read; only the city is shown, never a place.
caption: Spots with time, spotter, car, city, counted, night, source and signals

signal.burst_rule: More than :count spots by the same spotter within :minutes minutes.
signal.device_rule: Several spotting accounts on one app install.
signal.hop_rule: Two spots by the same spotter in cities more than :km km apart within :minutes minutes.
signal.device_off: Same device is not detected yet: installs are only stored per member so far.

empty_body: As soon as members scan cars in the app, the spots show up here with city and time.
empty_body_removed: Every spot so far has been removed. They are still listed under “Removed”.
view_only: View only: removing spots needs the right to take moderation decisions.

remove.title: Remove spot?
remove.body: The spot leaves the spotter's Dex and its XP is taken back. The car's spot counts and Build Score and the set progress are recomputed. A set that is no longer complete without this spot loses its completion and the XP for it. Badges stay.
remove.body_many: Each spot is removed and logged on its own, and its XP is taken back. Spot counts, Build Scores and set progress are recomputed once afterwards. A set that is no longer complete without these spots loses its completion and the XP for it. Badges stay. At most :max at a time.

bulk.busy: A bulk removal of yours is still running. Wait until it has finished.
bulk.window: You cannot remove more than 100 spots in 24 hours on your own. You can remove the rest from tomorrow.

flash.already: The spot had already been removed

record.title: Spot of :date
record.error: The spot could not be loaded.
record.context_intro: Spots by the same spotter one hour before and after this one.
record.context_empty: No other spots in this hour.
record.removals_intro: Removed spots of this spotter, newest first.
record.removals_empty: No spot of this spotter has been removed yet.
